framework_lessons: Separate asset value from financing survival.
assessment: This report contains several unusually testable calls. The Fed-pause deadline and six-to-twelve-month Treasury thesis failed; the named deferred oil contract also settled below its quoted entry reference. Alphabet and Bitcoin appreciated over the first three years of their three-to-five-year theses, with substantial interim volatility. Core Scientific's bankruptcy is a material company-selection miss. The Terra discussion largely repeats an already successful prior warning and should not inflate forecast counts. Conditional risks and valuation opinions are retained without forcing binary grades.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
